paper.title: Subroutines for the Computation of Mathieu Characteristic Numbers and their General Orders (title as in the TOMS/CALGO index; not verified against the paper)

code.commit: netlib TOMS archive 855.zip, sha256 3ed63d4389cec03acf2822a43e87caa9c1d829477e32f83b064eb1ef82ae1154 (fetched 2026-11-26 20:41Z). Contents: 855/CPP/Dp/Src/mcnf.cpp, mcnr.cpp; 855/CPP/Dp/Drivers/driver.cpp, Res; 855/Doc/Makefile; 855/855.head.
code.note: Driver and sources are C++ (Builder-era headers in driver.cpp: <cstdio>, <iostream>, <complex>; it defines inline acosh and asinh, which may clash with the C++ standard library; rerun must adapt the build, not the algorithm). The Makefile builds driver and runs `driver > res`; the shipped Res file is that output without the build. Recipe: compile mcnf.cpp, mcnr.cpp, driver.cpp with g++ and run the driver; the Table 2 rows are printed by the driver in the order of the loop in driver.cpp lines 158-195.

claim.location: Shipped reference file CPP/Dp/Drivers/Res, Table 2 (nu = 10.5000), row t = 1.50: the c column (middle of cl, c, cu) = 130.971685.
claim.metric: Mathieu characteristic number c computed by Compute_c(nu=10.5, mu=0, h=t*nu) at t=1.50 (h=15.75), printed %1.6lf in Table 2 of the driver output. The cl and cu columns are the driver's analytic bounds and are not the claim.
claim.paper_value: Not used: the paper (ACM DL) was not read; the claim rests on the archive's reference output, as artifact-reference.

tolerance.basis: Fixed before any run. The shipped value is printed with %1.6lf, so 1e-6 is one unit in the sixth decimal, the same basis as the 616 claim. A larger difference is a finding to diagnose (compiler, the iterative Compute_c accuracy parameter acc, precision), not a licence to loosen it.

cost.cpu_minutes_estimate: Under 1 minute for the Table 2 loop (a few hundred root solves of small order); the full driver is a few minutes at most.
cost.data_size: None: the driver generates all inputs.
cost.data_licence: Netlib CALGO (ACM) code under the ACM licence; rerun should record the licence text from the archive.

why: The c value needs Compute_c to solve for the characteristic number at a non-trivial h, not a closed form; the same table prints analytic bounds cl and cu, so a wrong c would show as falling outside them.
